title: Variable Scope and Lifetime

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Variable Scope and Lifetime** as part of **Kotlin Syntax and Basic Structure**. Apply variable scope and lifetime by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Local Variables, Block Scope, Top-Level Scope—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
